---
title: Built-in Rust syntax highlighting
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      dom-parity: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        # Both the canonical `rust` class and the `rs` alias resolve to
        # the built-in Rust grammar: the outer container carries
        # `sourceCode`, keywords wrap in `hl-keyword`, and a macro
        # invocation's name wraps in `hl-function-macro`.
        - ["<pre class=\"sourceCode rust\"", "<pre class=\"sourceCode rs\"", "hl-keyword\">fn</span>", "hl-function-macro\">println</span>"]
---

Rust fences are highlighted whether they use the canonical `rust` class or
the `rs` alias.

```rust
fn main() {
    let x: u32 = 1;
    println!("x = {x}");
}
```

```rs
fn main() {}
```
